citations.excerpt: A religious movement which was originated in 1739 by John Wesley in the Anglican Church , and subsequently gave rise to numerous separate denominations .
In 1739 Wesley organized the first Methodist Society, laid the foundation of the first separate place of worship at Bristol , and also opened a chapel (The Foundry) in London .

facts.value: Movement begun by John Wesley within the Church of England that later gave rise to separate Methodist denominations.
